proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4147.3 gāvī gives Hindi and neighboring gāi/gāy cow. These Dang/Kathoriya gaiya-like forms match the already reviewed feminine cow expansion, retaining the final -ya and nasal or raised glide details as regional qualifications. Exact survey form gə̃ⁱya is preserved.
